verdict.rationale: Kitty runs on macOS and Linux: the install docs cover Linux desktop integration, community users run it on macOS, and one user notes the config fits in a dotfiles repo. Windows support is not evidenced, and one user who moved to WSL 2 says kitty is "the only thing I miss from Linux," which implies no native Windows build. missing for 10: native Windows support, first-party documentation of supported platforms and config portability across operating systems.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same terminal with the same config on macOS, Linux, and Windows

citations.quote: Just tried kitty on MacOS -- Loved it.
it fits in a dotfiles repo
